text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, a while after the Twinkle
Series has
calmed down...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm on my way to a hot spring with

Matikanetannhauser, just like we
promised.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hot spring! Hot spring! ♪ See how it
steams! See
how it steams! ♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, want a snack, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I have hard candy, chocolate, gum... I
bought
everything I could for under 300
yen!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Because you're not supposed to spend
more than
300 yen on snacks for a trip!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I spent the last ten yen on these little
pieces of
gum! These are the fruits of my
labor!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, go ahead and take whichever
you like
best! Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, and not only that! I brought some cards too! We've got to play a game later!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the train rolls on toward the hot
spring, I think
back on all the other train
rides we've been on.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh! This is, like, five times nicer
than the
place we went for my class trip!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We arrive at the inn safe and sound.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... I'm pretty sure they said
dinner is
served at six, so it looks like we
have some free
time.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Should we buy some souvenirs or do
some
sightseeing? Or maybe... Muuun.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah! And there's no set times for
this hot
spring, either!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Okay, let's go! Hello hot spring, my old
friend!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whew! That was just what the doctor
ordered.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Yeah, actually. I guess the hot
spring
really hit the spot.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
But I'm totally fine! We came all the way
out here
and there's so many places we
have to check out!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Are you sure? Really? A nap, you say...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I guess that's true. When I think of
vacations, I
always imagine people
wandering around the
whole time.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
But I guess it's fine since it's just the two
of us. We
can do anything we want this
trip...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I guess Matikanetannhauser really was
tired
because she doesn't wake up until
sunset.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Aghhh! I slept way too long!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All of the sightseeing spots are closed
already! I
really messed up this time.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
But I really wanted to make some
memories with
you during this trip.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, hold on! Isn't there a beach nearby?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we go check it out since we're
here?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wow... It's so beautiful! You can see
everything so
clearly even though it's
night.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And the breeze feels good too. It's a
good thing
we decided to come here.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe. This hot spring getaway is so
much fun!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, when I was packing last night,
I felt just
like I did before I went on a
class trip at my old
school.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I bought snacks, packed cards, and
thought of all
the sightseeing spots we'd
go to.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I was so excited that I barely slept.
Haha...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
But going on a trip with just the two of
us is a bit
different than going with
classmates.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Sure, we still relax and have fun all the
same,
but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It feels a bit special, too.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Things like napping at the hotel or going
to the
beach at night are like a special
secret, just
between us.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, forget I said that. I don't even know what I'm saying.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser smiles quietly to
herself and
watches the waves come and
go.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Let's go on another trip together
sometime.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Yay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sense that Matikanetannhauser and I
have
formed an irreplaceable bond dur—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh no! It's past dinner time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite everything, we've formed an

irreplaceable bond during our time
together.
